# KmperTrace

KmperTrace is a tracing and structured logging library for Kotlin Multiplatform (Android, iOS/Swift, Desktop, Wasm) with a CLI that rebuilds trace trees from plain logs.

Current release: 0.3.3. Maven coordinates: dev.goquick.kmpertrace:kmpertrace-runtime

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/pluralfusion/kmpertrace/blob/main/README.md): Overview, install, configuration and a first span.
- [Using KmperTrace with AI coding assistants](https://github.com/pluralfusion/kmpertrace/blob/main/docs/ai/AI-assistants.md): A block to paste into AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md, conventions, worked examples and common mistakes.

## Guides

- [Tracing and log binding](https://github.com/pluralfusion/kmpertrace/blob/main/docs/Tracing.md): Spans, attributes, trace snapshots and why a log line may show no trace.
- [Journeys](https://github.com/pluralfusion/kmpertrace/blob/main/docs/Journeys.md): Start a trace from a user or system trigger.
- [CLI user guide](https://github.com/pluralfusion/kmpertrace/blob/main/docs/CLI-UserGuide.md): The print and tui commands, flags and keys.

## Install and examples

- [CLI install instructions](https://github.com/pluralfusion/kmpertrace/blob/main/README.md#quick-start): Installer commands and requirements for kmpertrace-cli.
- [Sample app](https://github.com/pluralfusion/kmpertrace/tree/main/sample-app/src/commonMain/kotlin/dev/goquick/kmpertrace/sampleapp): A Compose Multiplatform app that uses spans and logs.

## iOS

- [KMP app with Swift host code](https://github.com/pluralfusion/kmpertrace/blob/main/docs/IOS-KMP-Swift.md): Call KmperTrace from Swift through a KMP framework.
- [iOS XCFramework](https://github.com/pluralfusion/kmpertrace/blob/main/docs/IOS-XCFramework.md): Use the runtime in a pure Swift app.

## Support

- [GitHub issues](https://github.com/pluralfusion/kmpertrace/issues): Report a bug, ask for a platform or point out wrong docs. Include the version, platform and a minimal reproduction.
